title: It didn't work well for me.  I pumped and pumped and switched to my vacuum sealer
text: It didn't work well for me.  I pumped and pumped and switched to my vacuum sealer. The accessories for this are great, but the pump took too long.  I guess if it's all I had, I would tough my way through it but it just took too long.  The adapters for the jars are fabulous and the bonus of the lids are great too. All in all for the price it's a good deal

product_metadata.title: Jar Sealer and Accessory Hose Kit, 18Pcs Jar Sealing Kit for Regular and Wide Mouth Jars Compatible with FoodSaver Suction Port Vacuum Nozzle 5.5mm to 6mm(with Manual Portable Vacuum Pump)
features: WIDE MOUTH AND REGULAR MOUTH JAR SEALER KIT: Suitable for Two Kinds of mason jars. Made of high-quality food-grade silicone, BPA free, compact design. Draws air out of your mason jar, creating a vacuum seal to keep food fresh, maintain food quality, extend the freshness of food, reduce spoilage and food waste, and bring you a very safe and healthy life. Great for sauce, mustard, grains, nuts and jam storage, etc.

ALL IN ONE SET: This mason jar vacuum sealer kit comes with 1*Wide Mouth Sealer, 1*Regular Sealer, 2* Hose Connector (1 for FoodSaver vacuum sealer machine, 1 for extension hose to connect to other vacuums) 1*Manual Air Pump (for Manual Air Extraction), 1*User Guide, 6*Wide Mouth Mason Jar Lids(86mm), 6*Regular Mouth Mason Jar Lids(70mm), 1*can opener

UPGRADE STRUCTURE WIDE COMPATIBLE: XIANKE Jar sealing kit adopts 2 section food grade silicone pumping hose structure that can be used in the FoodSaver vacuum sealer machine and the vacuum machine with convex external pumping interface. For the latter, connect our thick hose to the thin hose then connected to the convex rod vacuum nozzle (5.5mm-6mm), and your vacuum sealer can work.

MANUAL PORTABLE AIR PUMP: If you don't have a vacuum machine, you can use our included handheld air pump to pump air out of the mason jars. The handheld vacuum sealer pump can also remove the air inside the mason jar perfectly.

[GREAT SERVICE & DISHWASHER-SAFE]: If there have any issues with our Foodsaver accessories, please do not hesitate to contact us and we will provide you with a satisfactory answer within 24 hours. Our durable jar sealers are easy to clean, washable, and dishwasher safe.
